rows.text: Reciting his suspension by Decree No. 1328 and citing the referendum of 25 April 1993, Article 121-3 and points 11 and 17 of Article 121-5 of the Constitution, Article 8 of the Law 'О Президенте РСФСР' and Decree No. 1452 of 25 September 1993, point 1 of Decree No. 1576 releases him from office ('Освободить Руцкого А.В. от должности вице-президента Российской Федерации'); point 4 puts the decree into force 'с момента его подписания'. It is signed 'Президент Российской Федерации Б.Ельцин, Москва, Кремль, 3 октября 1993 года, № 1576'.
rows.locator: Preamble; points 1 and 4; signature and date block

rows.text: Point 3 establishes that, in connection with the release, the powers of the President are exercised by the Chairman of the Council of Ministers - Government of the Russian Federation in the event of the President's resignation, inability to exercise his powers or death.
